The specification does not fully define whether divider and filter expiration are evaluated using pre-update or post-update counter values; this model treats a zero counter as expiring on the current eligible clock and reloads it on that clock.

The specification does not fully define the exact synchronization and filter pipeline cycle alignment for transition detection and read capture; this model uses registered two-stage synchronization, pre-update filtered values for protocol decisions, and majority-history updates on the current clock.

The specification describes asynchronous reset behavior, but the step interface provides no separate event mechanism for changes between calls; this model applies asynchronous reset whenever nReset is observed low during a step.
